sv.title: Susanne Nyström: Ingen trollkarl kommer att svinga sin stav över regeringsförhandlingarna
sv.summary: Andreas Norlén har gett partiledarna en tydlig deadline. Senast till jul ska en ny regering vara på plats. Annars väntar extra val.

en.title: Susanne Nyström: No wizard will wave his wand over the government negotiations
en.summary: Andreas Norlén has given the party leaders a clear deadline. No later than Christmas a new government must be in place. Otherwise, snap elections await.
